storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP LinkedIn DL makes it easy to save content from your LinkedIn feed and post pages.

How it works: Navigate to your LinkedIn feed or any post page, then click the extension icon. It scans the visible posts and detects videos, images, and text content. Browse what was found using the Videos, Images, and Text tabs, then download individual items or everything at once.

Videos from LinkedIn's DASH streaming CDN are captured automatically. Images are filtered to include only meaningful post content — profile photos, icons, and UI elements are excluded. Post text is saved as clean text files with the original post URL and timestamp.

All downloads are organized into folders by author name, with dates in the filename when available.

Key features:
- Scans LinkedIn feed and post pages for videos, images, and text
- Detects video streams from HTML5 elements, embedded metadata, and CDN requests
- Smart image filtering — captures post images, excludes profile photos and icons
- Saves post text as clean text files with post URL and timestamp
- Bulk download — save all visible content with one click
- Auto-organizes downloads by author name
- Tabbed popup UI — browse Videos, Images, and Text separately
- Dark-themed UI with LinkedIn blue accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to LinkedIn.com — your feed, a post page, or a video page
3. Click the extension icon to scan visible content
4. Browse detected assets and download what you need

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a LinkedIn video?
faq.answer: Go to a LinkedIn page with video content (feed, post, or video page), then click the extension icon. It scans the page and shows detected videos. Click download on any video.

faq.question: What types of content can I download?
faq.answer: Videos, images, and post text. Videos save as MP4, images save in their original format (JPG, PNG, etc.), and text posts save as TXT files.

faq.question: Does this capture every image on the page?
faq.answer: No — it uses smart filtering. Profile photos, company logos, icons, emojis, and small UI elements are excluded. Only meaningful post and article images are captured.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Files save to a LinkedIn Downloader folder inside your Downloads directory, organized by author name. Filenames include the date when available.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Can I download from any LinkedIn page?
faq.answer: The extension works on feed pages, individual post pages (/posts/), video pages (/video/), activity update pages (/feed/update/), and recent activity pages.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All content scanning and processing happens locally in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored. The extension only reads content you can already see on the page.
